claim_text: SoSNIE 2026 showed a significant shift in the depth and breadth of the experiment’s scope and participation.

evidence.text: Source summary of the April 8, 2026 article and March 18 photo captions: NIWC Atlantic describes the 2026 SoSNIE as the seventh annual experiment. Joint forces and engineers tested end-to-end mission threads and emerging technologies. The experiment involved more than 40 communications technologies and more than 150 participants from military services, government and industry.

Source summary: The event facilitated direct warfighter feedback on command-and-control prototypes. Its stated goals include finding opportunities for greater interoperability and strengthening digital architecture. Activities took place at NIWC Atlantic and off South Carolina, using manned and unmanned systems on land, at sea and in the air. The article also describes the 2026 iteration as a significant shift in the depth and breadth of the experiment’s scope and participation.

Source summary of the March 26, 2025 article: The annual SoSNIE held in 2025 is described as the seventh year the command hosted the event. The article reports approximately 45 systems and approximately 240 active participants and attendees. It says the team hoped to continue its growth into 2026.
